message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red left border. At the top, grey text reads "Film Pilihan 2012" next to a small typewriter icon. Below, the large red word "TEMPO" sits above smaller black text "EDISI 17-23 DESEMBER 2012". Large black capital letters in the center read "TIGA MALLARANGENG".

The main image features three men standing on a white boat against a backdrop of light blue sky and water. The man on the left wears a dark t-shirt and holds up a tan fabric bag marked with a black pound sterling symbol ("£"). The central man wears a dark t-shirt and light shorts, smiling forward. The man on the right wears a light blue t-shirt and a light bucket hat. 

All three men jointly hold a massive, rolled-up cylinder that resembles a United States hundred-dollar bill. The roll features Ben Franklin’s portrait and text including "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" and "731A". Two fishing rods with gold reels lean against the boat's sides. At the bottom, a barcode sits next to text indicating "RP 29.700", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN 0126-4273".
